indices.standing_risk_en: 🎲 Standing daily risk: 2.59%/day. This is a MARKET-IMPLIED probability — real money on Polymarket — not a forecast by this page and not a sensor reading. It comes from one open contract, "Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through November 15?", which resolves on an air or missile strike by either side against the other: its price implies a 42% chance of such a strike before 2026-11-16, with 21 days left to run. The figure published is the PER-DAY rate, not the contract price: a contract price falls on its own as expiry approaches even when nothing has changed, so only the daily rate is comparable from one week to the next. Casts no vote.
